trimmingSuggestions.description: The extended arm in Michelangelo's painting could be shortened, as the visual metaphor is already established within a few seconds.
Some of the "bombs" representing various technologies could be removed, as the core message about potential dangers is conveyed effectively with fewer examples.
The list of "game-changing" technologies could be shortened or presented more dynamically to maintain visual interest.

youtube_description:
2018 and 2019 were 2 amazing years, with some really great gigs - over 150 engagements in 30 countries. Now, my producer and art director Jean Francois Cardella and the TFA Studio team has compiled the best moments in this fast-moving video.  If you want to know what I do, and what my key messages are... just watch this!

Download the MP4 via Gerd Cloud: https://gerd.io/2RpjjSW

Gerd Leonhard Futurist, Author and Keynote Speaker 
Zürich / Switzerland  
http://www.futuristgerd.com 

If you enjoy my videos and talks, please take a look at my recent book “Technology vs Humanity” http://www.techvshuman.com or buy it via Amazon http://gerd.fm/globalTVHamazon  - the book is available in English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean and French (and more to come soon)

CEO http://www.thefuturesagency.com
